books_completion_consistency_check.name: books_completion_consistency_check
books_completion_consistency_check.value:
(
        "books"."status" = 'COMPLETED'
        and ("books"."current_page" = "books"."total_pages" or "books"."completed_via_document")
        and "books"."completed_at" is not null
      ) or (
        "books"."status" <> 'COMPLETED'
        and "books"."completed_at" is null
      )

reading_sessions_page_range_check.name: reading_sessions_page_range_check
reading_sessions_page_range_check.value: ("reading_sessions"."source" = 'EPUB' and "reading_sessions"."start_page" = 0 and "reading_sessions"."end_page" = 0 and "reading_sessions"."locations_read" > 0) or ("reading_sessions"."source" <> 'EPUB' and "reading_sessions"."start_page" >= 0 and "reading_sessions"."end_page" > "reading_sessions"."start_page" and "reading_sessions"."locations_read" = 0)

reminder_deliveries_skip_reason_check.name: reminder_deliveries_skip_reason_check
reminder_deliveries_skip_reason_check.value:
(
        "reminder_deliveries"."status" = 'SKIPPED'
        and "reminder_deliveries"."skip_reason" is not null
      ) or (
        "reminder_deliveries"."status" <> 'SKIPPED'
        and "reminder_deliveries"."skip_reason" is null
      )

reminder_deliveries_channel_check.name: reminder_deliveries_channel_check
reminder_deliveries_channel_check.value:
(
        "reminder_deliveries"."status" in ('SENT', 'FAILED')
        and "reminder_deliveries"."delivery_channel" is not null
      ) or (
        "reminder_deliveries"."status" = 'SKIPPED'
        and "reminder_deliveries"."delivery_channel" is null
      ) or "reminder_deliveries"."status" in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

streak_partnerships_pause_check.name: streak_partnerships_pause_check
streak_partnerships_pause_check.value: ("streak_partnerships"."status" = 'PAUSED' and "streak_partnerships"."paused_by_user_id" is not null) or ("streak_partnerships"."status" <> 'PAUSED' and "streak_partnerships"."paused_by_user_id" is null)
